policy: Refund policy v4. Support agents may approve a refund themselves only when ALL of the following hold: the charge is a confirmed duplicate, the amount is 50 USD or less, and the account has had no refund in the last 90 days. Anything else must be sent to a human reviewer. Agents must never state or imply that a refund will be approved before a reviewer has decided.
